items.title: Anthropic prices initial public offering
items.summary_en: Anthropic announced the pricing of its IPO on 18 Nov 2026 at $83.00 per share. The offering covers 980 million Class A shares, with about 956 million sold by Anthropic and about 24 million by selling stockholders. Trading was set to begin 19 Nov on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker ANT.
items.notes: Corporate/financial announcement; category 'policy' is the closest schema fit. Share counts are as summarized from the page by the fetch tool; the later closing post reports a larger total including the underwriters' option.

items.title: Anthropic announces closing of IPO and concurrent private placement
items.summary_en: Anthropic reported on 20 Nov 2026 that its IPO closed, with Class A stock trading on Nasdaq since 19 Nov (ticker ANT). Total 1.127 billion shares were sold at $83.00, including the underwriters' full option of 147 million shares, for about $93.5 billion gross (about $91.6 billion to Anthropic). A concurrent private placement of about 313 million Class N shares at $83.00 went to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA and TSMC Partners, for about $26.0 billion, bringing combined gross proceeds to about $119.5 billion.
items.notes: Corporate/financial announcement; category 'policy' is the closest schema fit. Figures as summarized by the fetch tool from the official page.

items.title: Anthropic introduces Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
items.summary_en: Fable 5.2 is available on major cloud platforms and via API as claude-fable-5-2, priced at $8 per million input and $40 per million output tokens (fast mode $16/$80). Anthropic says it beats Claude Opus 5.5 on nearly all evaluated capabilities and is about 30% faster than Fable 5.1. Mythos 5.2 is the same underlying model with certain cyber and biology safeguards removed, restricted to vetted cybersecurity and life-sciences organizations. Anthropic reports low alignment risk in high-stakes settings, and says external evaluators including UK AI Security Institute and METR tested it before release.
items.notes: Published 9 Nov, about 19 days before run date and just outside the 10-day window; included as the most recent model release and because it is the context for the IPO items and the mention of external evaluators (relevant to the evaluator-institute collectors). Capability and safety claims are Anthropic's own; no independent evaluator reports were checked here.

coverage_note: Within the 18-28 Nov window, the Anthropic newsroom listed only two posts: IPO pricing (18 Nov) and IPO closing (20 Nov). The listing also showed a 28 Nov date heading with no title or link, so no item was created for it. The Nov 9 Fable/Mythos 5.2 release and a 10 Nov roadshow post are earlier than the window; only the model release is included. No safety, research or policy posts were found in the window. Other posts since the last run (Sept-Oct 2026, e.g. Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, Cyber Mission, 'An update on independent evaluators' on 15 Oct) were not collected because they are outside the window; the Orchestrator may reassign if wanted. Official social channels were not checked. Newsroom pages were fetched directly from anthropic.com; secondary outlets in search results were not used.
